column1: # tools/css/gen-css-tables.py: value types the pinned data names and does not define, with the definition the served draft gives. Columns, tab

# separated: scope (the property the pin nests the type in, or empty for a global type), name (without the angle brackets), grammar, source (the draft, and the sentence that gives the definition, quoted). A line for a
# name whose pin entry has a grammar fails generation (the supplement is stale then, and the pin wins). The sentences are from the Editor's
# Drafts as served on 2026-10-26 (drafts.csswg.org); the pin is the data of tools/css/WEBREF_COMMIT.
